overview_description.description: Slite is the fastest way to access trusted company information. Powered by AI, Slite’s knowledge base enables growing teams to instantly get the answers they need - without even searching. From onboarding guides to all hands notes, your company docs are centralised, organised, and always up-to-date. Replace all-in-one workspaces with a tool built for company knowledge and see it scale with your team. Join more than 200,000 companies that use Slite as their single source of truth today.

product.name: Slite Knowledge Base
product.description: A cloud-based collaborative platform for teams to create, organize, and manage shared documentation and knowledge.

product.name: AI-powered Wiki Generator
product.description: An AI tool that helps teams automatically generate structured documentation and wiki content to accelerate knowledge base creation.

product.name: AI Answers and Editor Assistant
product.description: AI-driven features that provide automated answers to questions and assist with document editing within the Slite platform.

product.name: Knowledge Management Panel
product.description: A management interface that allows bulk actions and organization of documents within the knowledge base to maintain order and structure.

product.name: Integrations and API
product.description: A set of integrations and an API that connect Slite with other tools like Slack, Google Drive, Jira, and more to embed content and automate workflows.
